title: Calibration Station
text: A mirror-rock and crystal observatory in the Dislocated Geodes. Its calibration corridor holds deflection clusters at different growth stages. A Spatial Stability Anchor protects the surrounding area from deflection and teleportation.

The storeroom holds two item treasure orbs and one random fluid treasure orb. Supplies include deflection and spatial crystals, occasional Space Microcores and Space Warp Points, and other laboratory materials.
